'''Tuanjin''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lake Heights}} that appears during the evening.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tuanjin:''' Hey? You must be that Rover. How are you?
:{{DIcon}} Are you a Patroller? Anything happened here?
:'''Tuanjin:''' No, no, don't worry. I just got off work and decided to pay a visit.
:'''Tuanjin:''' There are names I know here... they're lonely souls, so I visit them from time to time.
:'''Tuanjin:''' And as you can see, there are lots of seniors here. If anything happens, I'll be around to help out.
:'''Tuanjin:''' Even though I'm off duty, as long as I'm wearing this uniform, I'm still a Patroller, and I have a duty to protect people.
{{Dialogue End}}
